data.name: Basketball Pick Up Game
data.headline: Complimentary | Sun, Tue, Thur | 2pm
data.description: Join our Recreation Team in a fun pick up Basketball Match! All ages are welcome!
data.what_is_included: Court rental is icluded for the hour. Basketballs will be provided.
data.what_is_not_included: you are welcome to bring your own water botttles if needed.
data.cancellation_summary: Please email the Recreation Department at recreation@paradisepoint.com to inform us of your cancellation.
data.cancellation_notes:
Cancellations made at least 24 hours in advance are eligible for a full refund or credit. If we need to cancel your reservation due to weather or other unforeseen circumstances, you will also receive a full refund or credit.

**To cancel or inquire about your reservation, please contact us by phone 619-247-9345**. No-shows and cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation will be charged in full.
data.booking_notes:
You're all set. Please head over to the Basketball Court at the schedule date/time to meet one of our Recreation team members for the activity.

Should you need to cancel, please let us know at least 2 hours in advance simply by replying to this email.

Thank you!
data.check_in_details: Meet the Recration Attendant at the Basketball Courts
